title: Bulk Delete — Runs and Engagements
goal: Allow operators to delete one or multiple runs and engagements with a clear impact summary and confirmation — keeping the data model clean without accumulating stale test data.
scope: Implement: (1) SINGLE RUN DELETE: DELETE /api/v1/runs/{run_id} with a dry_run=true preview mode that returns what will be deleted (tasks, findings, artifacts, remediation records, AI enrichments, chain detections, agent proposals). Soft-delete (deleted_at timestamp) with a 30-day hard-delete background job. Running runs cannot be deleted — return 409 with 'Stop the run before deleting'. (2) BULK RUN DELETE: DELETE /api/v1/runs with a body of run_ids list. Same dry-run preview. (3) ENGAGEMENT DELETE: DELETE /api/v1/engagements/{id} with cascade preview showing: N runs, N findings, N artifacts, N scheduled runs, N integration configs. Requires explicit confirmation string (engagement name). (4) UI — RUNS: Each run card in History/Mission Control gets a checkbox on hover. A bulk action bar slides up when ≥1 run is checked: 'Delete N runs [confirmation]'. Individual run cards get a '...' menu with Delete option. (5) UI — ENGAGEMENTS: The engagement dropdown gets a Manage Engagements screen (or modal) showing all engagements as rows with a Delete button per row and a select-all bulk delete option. (6) AUDIT: All deletes are logged to audit_events with actor, timestamp, and item count. Deleted items are excluded from all API responses immediately.
generation_reason: There is currently no delete functionality in AegisPT. Operators accumulate test runs, acceptance runs, and stale engagements with no way to clean them up. After running 50+ acceptance tests, the engagement list becomes cluttered. Bulk delete with a clear impact preview is standard in every data management UI.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Soft-delete with 30-day hard-delete. Running runs cannot be deleted. Engagement delete requires confirmation string. All deletes audit-logged. No cascade delete of pack artifacts or capability packs — those are independent.

success_criteria: DELETE /api/v1/runs/{id} with dry_run=true returns impact summary.
Running runs return 409 on delete attempt.
DELETE /api/v1/engagements/{id} requires confirmation string and cascades to runs/findings.
Deleted items excluded from all API responses immediately.
Audit event logged for every delete.
UI shows checkboxes on run cards with bulk action bar.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

before_promotion: Installation package (backlog-81) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with bulk delete implementation.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with soft-delete as active capability.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Hard delete on demand (30-day soft-delete only)
